svg.title: Wisconsin works with Korea
svg.desc: North-up Wisconsin map. Promega in Madison; Doosan Bobcat in Johnson Creek; Rockwell in Milwaukee; Oshkosh–Hanwha in Oshkosh. Neenah is shown for local context. Marathon County ginseng and Hsu’s use a representative Wausau locator, not a farm or company address. All city markers are Census representative points. Leader lines link labels to places, not transport routes.
